[A10] RULING 2026-11-21 (the open question)

Fan-out, not refusal. IEEE 1722.1-2021 ACMP lets each sink bind on its own (8.2), and no Milan v1.2 clause or ACMP status lets an entity refuse a second sink of its own on a stream it already receives; specs are authoritative here.

- The receive parser delivers one PDU to every monitor context bound to its stream_id (each input its own counters, its own media clock and render path).
- Gates: a failing test first (two inputs, then three, bound to one talker stream; unbinding one leaves the others receiving), the RTL suites and the twin, the CPU service-budget rows unchanged, fit and timing at 1x1/1if and 8x8/1if on best of three directives.
- If 8x8/1if does not fit or close timing with the fan-out, STOP with the measured cost; the area trade then comes back here.
- Work starts now on the flip train's head; its PR goes to dev-soft-core after the train merges.

[A810] TAKEN
Branch: `pf-948-1`, on the flip train's head `15168e14` (PR #945). Once the train merges, the PR's base is `dev-soft-core` and its diff is this lane's commits only.
Authoritative references: the ruling of 2026-11-21 above (fan-out, not refusal); IEEE 1722.1-2021 8.2 (each sink binds on its own); Milan v1.2 5.3.8.10 and Table 5.6 (the counters of each Stream Input), 5.3.8.7 (a stopped input discards).
Interpreted scope: the AVTP receive parser reports every bound table entry a PDU's stream_id matches, as a vector. The shared monitor engine judges and counts that one PDU once for each matched context, from its one queued bundle. The AAF depacketizer stores the frame once, commits it when the engine queues the PDU, and reads it out once for each input that accepted it, so each input has its own counters, clock-meter samples and render path. Nothing is copied per input. With one binding per stream the engine stays cycle-equal to its reference model. No mailbox, firmware or CPU budget bound changes.
Validation plan:
- Failing tests first, each with planted mutants:
  - the receive stack at eight contexts (`avtp_rxmon`): two inputs, then three, bound to one talker stream; unbinding one leaves the others receiving; counters per input;
  - the 8x8 datapath (`milan_dp`);
  - the twin's split half at 8x8/1if. The twin's own shape, 1x1, has one AAF Stream Input.
- Then the RTL suites, the full sweep in four shards, the twin and its plants, the firmware gate, and the CPU budget images (unchanged).
- Fit and timing at 1x1/1if and 8x8/1if: the best of three directives, the floor at every corner, with slice and LUT deltas against the train's gating builds.
Blockers: none. The ruling's STOP applies if 8x8/1if does not fit or does not close timing.

[A810] REVIEW READY
Commit: `4ceba3d40e3b94e9bda2407e64ef906c283b63a4` (`pf-948-1`, on the flip train's head `15168e14`; not pushed, the PR is the manager's to open)

Changed:
- `hdl/ieee1722/avtp/avtp_stream_parser.sv`: `match_vec_o`, every enabled table entry a PDU's stream_id matches. The highest index stays, for the APRB probe.
- `hdl/ieee1722/avtp/KL_avtp_rx_monitor_ctx.sv`: a queued bundle holds the matched-and-bound vector, and the walker serves the one bundle to each context in turn. Each context gets its own format compare, sequence state, counters and accept. New for the depacketizer: an enqueue pulse one cycle after the match, and a done pulse with the accepting contexts. With one binding per stream the engine is cycle-equal to its reference.
- `hdl/ieee1722/aaf/KL_aaf_rx_depacketizer.sv`:
  - A frame is committed on the enqueue and read out of its one stored copy once per accepting input, tuser that input. A frame no input accepted is passed over.
  - Its own frame store (`axis_fifo` cannot read a frame twice) and a four-entry verdict queue.
  - A full store's drop counts for the frame's accepting inputs.
- `hdl/milan/milan_datapath.sv`: the wiring. The 5.3.8.7 stop gate on the done mask, input by input. The AAF clock meter sees the followed input's bit of the match vector.
- Tests below; the four test wraps; `tb_split_top.sv`'s `N_STREAMS_P` (default 1).
- Docs: `DATAPLANE_WALKTHROUGH.md`, `FPGA_DESIGN.md`, `TESTING.md`, the `milan_dp` and `milan_dp_mclk` READMEs.
- Not changed: the mailbox contract, the firmware, and every CPU budget image and bound.

Validation:
- Failing first (base RTL, then the head):
  - `make -C tb/verilator/avtp_rxmon fanout`, the stack at N=8, [FO1]-[FO10]: 118 of 239 failed, then 239 of 239 passed.
  - `sim_nxn` [FAN] on the 8x8 datapath (ACMP binds 4+6, then 7, unbind 4; FRAMES_RX, DEPKT tally, GET_COUNTERS): 11 of 4027 failed, then 0.
  - `make -C tb/verilator/milan_dp twin-fanout`, the twin's split half at 8x8/1if with the 8x8 split image's firmware: 8 failed (input 0 counted 0 of 4 beside input 1, the bench's case), then 0.
  - `milan_dp_mclk --shared`, each input its own media clock: the meter following input 0 never locked, then it locks on input 0 and on input 1.
- Planted defects: `fanout_mutants.py` 12 of 12 caught. `twin-fanout-plants` (the one-entry parser): 4 of 4 words. `milan_dp_mclk` 36 of 36, with mutant 19 (the parser's one index) and mutant 9 re-planted at the meter's new selection.
- The sweep, `run_all_suites.sh --shard k/4`, four units, at `c2e5e5bd`: 64 of 65 suites, 2,713,403 checks.
  - The one failure: `milan_dp_mclk`'s mutant 9 survived because the first wiring made the meter's compare redundant. Fixed in `09e78e41`, and that suite reran at `09e78e41`: 36 of 36.
  - Since `c2e5e5bd` the head changes RTL comments, the `milan_dp_mclk` files and the documentation inventory only.
  - The four declared `tsn_fuzz` skips. Its AAF campaign, which drives this depacketizer, ran with the generator: 164 pass, the results artifact fresh.
- The `avtp_rxmon` suite: lockstep 116 and 119 against the reference, all four campaigns.
- The twin, `twin-plants`, `twin-maps` and `twin-maps-plants`: `twin: 0 finding(s)`, every plant refused.
- The firmware gate (four shards), `fw_coverage --check`, `run.py --self-test`, the publication census: PASS.
- The 12 CPU budget images are byte-identical to the train's record at `15168e14`. The rows' checks print what the base prints: `flip_check`'s 8x8/2if rows are the base's, reported and not held.
- The docs workflow steps 104 of 104; `lint_rtl.py --check` 89 <= 89; `xvlog_gate.py --check` 0 findings; the Yosys gate on the three touched tops.
- Fit and timing at `e8a877a0` (the head's RTL but for comments): the gating recipe, #818's three directives, one Vivado at a time.

  | Point | Directive | Slow WNS / WHS (ns) | Fast WNS / WHS (ns) | LUTs | FFs | Slices | BRAM tiles |
  |---|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
  | 8x8/1if | ExtraPostPlacementOpt | +0.061 / +0.102 | +1.566 / +0.033 | 44,277 | 51,076 | 15,659 | 94 |
  | 8x8/1if | **ExtraTimingOpt** | **+0.332** / +0.100 | +1.641 / +0.036 | 44,291 | 51,076 | 15,431 | 94 |
  | 8x8/1if | AltSpreadLogic_high | +0.313 / +0.102 | +1.641 / +0.036 | 44,312 | 51,078 | 15,421 | 94 |
  | 1x1/1if | ExtraPostPlacementOpt | +0.085 / +0.102 | +1.660 / +0.028 | 32,543 | 42,660 | 13,671 | 79.5 |
  | 1x1/1if | **ExtraTimingOpt** | **+0.317** / +0.096 | +1.636 / +0.029 | 32,548 | 42,660 | 14,299 | 79.5 |
  | 1x1/1if | AltSpreadLogic_high | +0.201 / +0.096 | +1.636 / +0.029 | 32,524 | 42,661 | 14,285 | 79.5 |

  - #818's floor (WNS >= +0.030, WHS >= 0) is met at every corner on every build. No worst path is in the receive path.
  - Deltas against the train's gating builds (ExtraPostPlacementOpt):
    - 8x8/1if: LUTs +1,292, FFs +83, slices -39 (-267 at the best directive), BRAM -0.5 tile.
    - 1x1/1if: LUTs -171, FFs +32, slices -22, BRAM -0.5 tile.
  - The fan-out's own cost is in the touched modules: +151 LUT and +119 FF at 8x8, +141 LUT and +48 FF at 1x1, and one RAMB18 fewer at each.
  - The rest of the 8x8 LUT move is outside them, in `KL_mbx_cdc/u_edit` (+1,700) and `milan_datapath/csr` (-1,196), the attribution of one cross-boundary path's logic (8 threads here, 16 in the train's builds).

Acceptance criteria (#948's ruling of 2026-11-21):
- Fan-out, each input its own counters, media clock and render path: met. Counters: FRAMES_RX, the Table 5.6 set and GET_COUNTERS per input. Media clock: the meter on either input of a shared stream. Render path: each input's own copy, its own tuser, at the depacketizer's output.
- A failing test first, two then three inputs, an unbind leaving the others receiving: met, in the RTL suite, the 8x8 datapath and the twin.
- The RTL suites and the twin: met.
- The CPU service-budget rows unchanged: met (images byte-identical).
- Fit and timing at 1x1/1if and 8x8/1if, best of three: met. No STOP.

Open risks/questions:
- The CPU clock's margin moves between near-identical netlists. An intermediate head's route (`b9a88d25`, a three-bit mux on the meter's index, withdrawn in `09e78e41` so the routes above stand) gave Slow WNS +0.007 ns at ExtraTimingOpt on `KL_mbx`'s face registers (CPU clock, 79 % route), against +0.332 here. Not this lane's logic.
- The stricter both-+0.030 floor another lane's ruling used is met at 8x8. At 1x1 it is missed by 1-2 ps of Fast-corner hold (+0.028/+0.029) on unrelated paths (`KL_mbx_dma`; the monitor's unchanged legacy counter register into the CSR snapshot).
- The DEPKT drop tally now counts a full store's drop for the frame's accepting inputs, and a foreign frame's drop only in the total. It used to charge every drop to the last accepted index.
- Index 0's `0x800` PDUS word stays the shared depacketizer total (unchanged, noted in the `milan_dp` README).

[A810] REVIEW READY
Commit: `e8252323e72635235539e56d381043d1c269df80` (`pf-948-1`, round 2 on round 1's `4ceba3d4`; not pushed, the manager pushes)

Answers R878-1 (F1, F2) and R877-1 (F1, R1, S1) under the manager's ruling on F2: (a) an AAF PDU whose
stream_data_length is not the bound input's frame size is discarded whole, per input, and counted; (b) the padded-tail
contract is made true; (c) the PR body says F2 predates #948 and was found by review.

Changed:
- `hdl/ieee1722/avtp/KL_avtp_rx_monitor_ctx.sv` (a):
  - The frame size is part of an input's format: channels_per_frame x samples_per_frame (IEEE 1722-2016 I.2.4.1) x
    the sample's octets (7.3.5, Table 9: 2, 3 or 4).
  - It is computed one state before the verdict (`flen_r`).
  - A PDU whose stream_data_length (4.4.4.10) is another size counts UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT at that input and has no
    accept, so that input receives none of it (Milan v1.2 4.4.2.2). An input whose size it matches receives it.
  - The lockstep reference carries the same lines.
- `hdl/ieee1722/aaf/KL_aaf_rx_depacketizer.sv` (b):
  - When a tail lies wholly in the hold register, the frame's last word is kept for the final beat, so the pass ends
    (rewind or release) on the beat that carries tlast.
  - A frame that ends short of its stream_data_length is dropped whole at its tlast, in `drops_o` and in its
    accepting inputs' DEPKT drops. The read side reads only complete payloads, and the old resync is defensive.
  - S1: the no-reset storage says why.
- Tests:
  - `sim_fanout` [FO11]-[FO13]; the new `sim_depkt` with `depkt_mutants.py` (7); `fanout_mutants.py` +7.
  - `sim_nxn` [FAN]: STOP and START of input 4, then 6. `fan_stop_plant.py` and `make fan-stop-plants` (2 plants).
- Stimulus made conformant (each harness's PDU at its format's frame size): `sim_lockstep`, `sim_main_nx`,
  `sim_ctxfmt`, `sim_nxn` (`FMT_LO` had samples_per_frame 0), and milan_dp's `sim_main` (the 8-channel shape sent 48
  octets).
- Docs:
  - The walkthrough's diagram and rows (R878-1 F1) and the meter's field table (R878-1 F1).
  - `FPGA_DESIGN.md`, `TESTING.md` (R877-1 R1's sentence break, the new legs), the `milan_dp` README.
  - `PCMRX_CNT`'s drops field, the evidence dispositions, the inventory.
- Not changed: `milan_datapath.sv`, the parser, the mailbox contract, the firmware, every CPU budget image.

Validation (failing first on round 1's RTL, then the head):
- `make -C tb/verilator/avtp_rxmon fanout`: 91 of 489 failed (FO11 24, FO12 58, FO13 9; FO1-FO10 pass), then 489 of

  - The base: 2,842 of 5,150 failed at each lead. 2,077 of the 2,760 [DT2] cases were whole, and DT1's 65-octet
    probe gave no frame.
  - The head: 369 of 369 at each lead, 2,760 of 2,760 cases.
- `sim_nxn` [FAN] STOP legs:
  - On the base's 8x8 datapath: 4,061 of 4,061 pass, because the gate is right. Both plants fail by name (shared: "input 4
    stopped: input 6 receives every PDU", "input 6 stopped: input 4 ..."; one-index: "the stopped input 4 receives
    nothing", "input 6 stopped: input 4 ...").
  - At the head: 4,061 of 4,061, and both plants caught again.
- Planted defects: `fanout_mutants.py` 19 of 19, `depkt_mutants.py` 7 of 7, `fan-stop-plants` 2 of 2. The suite's
  other arms still catch 13, 12 and 4.
- The `avtp_rxmon` suite at the head: flat 97, N=4 stack 218, lockstep N=1 116 and N=8 119, ctxfmt 96, fanout 489,
  depkt 369 twice, every arm PASS.
- The affected suites, each as `run_all_suites.sh` runs one (timeout, its log's masked-verdict check):
  - All 11 pass: `avtp_rxmon` (at the head), milan_dp 14,142 of 14,142 (`29ffa248`), `milan_dp_mclk` 173 (36 of
    36 cases), `aaf_audio_loop` 10.
  - `capture_coherence`, `follow_ring`, `mbx`, `milan_dp_gm_steps`, `milan_dp_render`, `pp_shadow` and `tsn_fuzz`:
    548,206 of 548,206 at `f89a3593`. Their tests and the RTL are unchanged since.
  - `tsn_fuzz`'s four declared skips (the generator campaigns) are not counted. Its AAF campaign ran with the
    generator, below.
  - One finding on the way: milan_dp at `f89a3593` failed 11 checks in obj_ax1x1. The root harness's PDU carried 8

- The twin, `twin-plants`, `twin-maps`, `twin-maps-plants`, `twin-fanout`, `twin-fanout-plants`: `twin: 0 finding(s)`,
  every plant refused.
- `tsn_fuzz`'s AAF campaign with its generator (the sweep's declared skip): 164 pass, its artifact fresh.
- The docs workflow steps 104 of 104 (em dash: 0 findings over 70 added lines); `lint_rtl.py --check` 89 <= 89;
  `xvlog_gate.py --check` 0 findings.
- Yosys on the touched tops: `KL_avtp_rx_monitor_ctx` 12,034 cells (10,916 at round 1) and `KL_aaf_rx_depacketizer`
  54,236 (53,546). Tied-input and tap-purity gates PASS.
- Fit and timing at `6ab8b355`: `hdl/`, `sw/`, `configs/` and the pinned processors are identical to the head.
  The gating recipe, #818's three placement directives, 8 Vivado threads, two Vivado at a time through

  - #818's floor (WNS >= +0.030 ns, WHS >= 0) is met at every corner on all six builds. The image identity
    gate agrees on each.
  - The touched modules' placed cost against round 1 at ExtraPostPlacementOpt:
    - 8x8: `aaf_rx_depkt` +106 LUT / +18 FF, `avtp_rx_monitor` +99 LUT / +22 FF and 2 DSP blocks (the
      frame-size product).

Acceptance criteria (the ruling on R878-1 F2 and the reviews' verification asks):
- (a) Off-size PDUs are discarded whole, per input, and counted: met. [FO11] includes the 65-octet probe through the
  fan-out path and two inputs of different sizes on one stream. The next valid PDU keeps its boundaries and index.
- (b) Padded tails: met. [DT1] is the 64-octet control and the 65-octet probe. [DT2] covers the tagged hold tail, two
  and four inputs, stalls at the last stored word, and an ordinary PDU after each. It grades bytes, tlast, tuser and
  emitted/drop accounting. The premature pass end is planted and caught.
- (c) The PR body states F2 predates #948 and was found by review: met (PR-BODY).
- R877-1 F1: met. STOP of one input of two with START restoring, FRAMES_RX still counting on the stopped input, and
  the review's shared gate caught by name.
- R878-1 F1, R877-1 R1, S1: met.
- Re-route (the RTL changed): met. #818's floor holds at every corner at 8x8/1if and 1x1/1if on all three
  directives. Best: 8x8 AltSpreadLogic_high +0.327 ns, 1x1 AltSpreadLogic_high +0.391 ns. No STOP.

Open risks/questions:
- New scope, predates #948 (not fixed here; needs a new Issue): a frame of 10 beats or fewer is counted in FRAMES_RX
  and never delivered.
  - A scratch probe through the receive stack finds 82 octets (11 beats) the shortest frame delivered, tagged or not,
    at the head and on `4ceba3d4`'s RTL alike.
  - The enqueue pulse lands after a shorter frame's tlast.
  - A 1-channel 48 kHz Base stream (62-octet frames) is reachable, since the inputs advertise Milan 6.4's family, and
    renders nothing. Before #948 the commit waited for the even later accept pulse.
- USER and the reserved format values fix no sample size in Table 9. The verdict sizes them as four octets, and no
  input of this entity advertises one.
- `PCMRX_CNT`'s drops half now also counts a queued PDU's frame short of its payload.

[A810] REVIEW READY
Commit: `64e55a59e09339114926c2600056c3ad8b33b9b4` (`pf-948-1`, round 2b on round 2's `e8252323`; not pushed, the manager pushes)

Answers the manager's ruling of 2026-11-22 on round 2's new scope: frames of ten beats or fewer were counted in
FRAMES_RX and never delivered, so a 1-channel 48 kHz Base stream rendered nothing. It is fixed in this PR. Round 2's
answers to R878-1 and R877-1 stand (issuecomment-7075385669); their evidence is rerun at this head below.

Measured first, at each revision through its own receive stack (`probe_minframe2.cpp`, input 0, 3 PDUs per length):
- At `15168e14` (the true base), the shortest delivered frame is 98 octets (13 beats). Milan's 2-channel 48 kHz frames
  (86 octets) and 1-channel ones (62, 66 tagged) were never delivered.
- At `4ceba3d4` (round 1) and `e8252323` (round 2), the shortest is 82 octets (11 beats). Round 1's enqueue commit made
  2-channel streams deliverable, so it changed the behaviour for the better, but 1-channel was still never delivered.
- At this head, every length from the Ethernet minimum up is delivered, tagged and untagged, the 1-channel 48 kHz Base
  frames included.
- The cause, at every revision: the monitor's enqueue pulse lands exactly three cycles after the tap carries a frame's
  eighth beat (the parser's input register, its registered match, the monitor's registered pulse). The depacketizer
  dropped a frame at its tlast unless that pulse had come, so a frame of eight to ten beats was gone before it. Before
  #948 the commit waited for the still later accept pulse.

Changed:
- `hdl/ieee1722/aaf/KL_aaf_rx_depacketizer.sv`:
  - The store's write side runs `ENQ_LAT_C` = 3 cycles behind the tap.
  - The tap's own beat count names each pulse's frame, the one that passed its eighth beat last (`taw_r`, `tq_r`,
    `te_r`).
  - Each frame's verdict is taken when its eighth beat reaches the write side, a pulse in that same cycle included.
    That is on or before its tlast, however short the frame.
  - An unqueued frame is still dropped at its tlast. Nothing else changes: the off-format discard in the monitor, the
    whole-payload check, the tail.
- Tests:
  - `sim_fanout` [FO14].
  - `sim_depkt` [DT4], with the bench's pulse now scheduled from the eighth beat at a chosen latency.
  - `sim_nxn` [FAN]: inputs 6 and 7 at one channel.
  - [FO8]: the cut 64-octet frame is now a DEPKT drop, as [FO13]'s frames are.
- Mutants: `depkt_mutants.py` +4 (11). `fanout_mutants.py` +2, and the round-1 "lost PDU" mutant re-anchored to its
  analogue in this design (21).
- Docs: the walkthrough's depacketizer row, `FPGA_DESIGN.md`, `TESTING.md`'s `avtp_rxmon` row, the `milan_dp` README,
  the evidence dispositions, the inventory.

Validation (failing first on `e8252323`'s RTL, the tests commit `0b4517c3`, then the head):
- `sim_fanout`: 236 of 1,205 failed (FO14 234; FO8's new drop check 2; FO1-FO13 pass), then 1,205 of 1,205. [FO14]:
  - Payloads of 2-42 octets in one channel of INT_16BIT, INT_24BIT or INT_32BIT, the Milan 1-channel 48 kHz Base
    format among them. Every remainder, untagged and tagged.
  - Frames of 8, 9 and 10 beats, two back to back (the second starts inside the first's three cycles), to two
    inputs, with another stream's PDU to a third input between them.
  - PDUs off the inputs' frame size, one octet each way, in equally short frames: discarded whole and counted as
    UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.
- `sim_depkt`, at no payload lead and at the datapath's 16:
  - `e8252323`'s RTL: 3,077 of 5,750 failed at each lead. [DT4] had 192 of 960 cases whole, and no frame for the
    1-channel PDU, untagged or tagged.
  - The head: 374 of 374 at each lead.
- `sim_nxn` (obj_nxn8): 6 of 4,073 failed, then 4,073 of 4,073. The failures were the 1-channel rounds: FRAMES_RX
  counted every PDU, DEPKT tallies 0.
- Plants re-breaking the short-frame path, each caught by name:
  - The store taking the tap as it comes: [DT4] and [FO14].
  - A pulse taken only while its frame is still on the tap: [DT4] and [FO14] 28 octets.
  - A same-cycle pulse missed, and a two-cycle lag: [DT4]'s 1-channel PDU.
  - The re-anchored mutant: [FO8].
  - All arms: `depkt_mutants.py` 11 of 11, `fanout_mutants.py` 21 of 21. The suite's other arms catch 13, 12 and 4.
- The `avtp_rxmon` suite at the head: flat 97, N=4 stack 218, lockstep N=1 116 and N=8 119, ctxfmt 96, fanout 1,205,
  depkt 374 twice. Every arm passes.
- The affected suites, each as `run_all_suites.sh` runs one: all 11 pass.
  - `avtp_rxmon`; milan_dp 14,148 checks; `milan_dp_mclk` 173 (36 of 36 cases).
  - `aaf_audio_loop`, `capture_coherence`, `follow_ring`, `mbx`, `milan_dp_gm_steps`, `milan_dp_render`,
    `pp_shadow` and `tsn_fuzz`: 548,216 checks.
  - milan_dp reached the sweep's 7,200 s wall clock inside its last phase, `render_mutants` (`rc=124`, the sweep's
    UNKNOWN, under a host load near 145). Every check before it had passed. That phase then ran alone on the same
